requirement:
Expandable coverage details contain current annotation explanations
and last recorded citation reviews. Test-run provenance and execution
measurements remain in saved artifacts rather than the generated book.
rationale: structural: `requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.combined.details` has no implementation roots, and none are needed. Every clause describes what the generated output contains, not how the code is built. - "Expandable coverage details contain current annotation explanations and last recorded citation reviews" only says what content the details show. An alternative could get that content from a different data source, module layout or rendering helper and produce the same book. So how it is built is discretionary. - "Test-run provenance and execution measurements remain in saved artifacts rather than the generated book" says what the book leaves out. It names no library, signature, type, field or delegation interface. Because every clause is observable behavior, behavioral tests can supply the evidence. No `{impl}` marker is required. behavioral: Obligations in `requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.combined.details`: (1) the expandable details contain the current annotation explanations; (2) they contain the last recorded citation reviews; (3) test-run provenance and execution measurements stay in saved artifacts and out of the generated book. I judged adequacy from the supplied test text and did not request implementation source. - Current explanations: `src/execution_coverage/check.rs#mod[tests]/fn[book_browses_all_proposals_while_cli_checks_reviews_and_measurements]` asserts that the rendered gaps chapter contains the doc-comment explanation "Invariant fallback, unreachable through the public API.". After the source is rewritten without a doc comment, it asserts "No tracked justification is present.", so the explanation follows the current source. - Last recorded reviews: the same test asserts "Recorded review: Missing" when no review exists. It then asserts "Recorded true", "Recorded false" and "Recorded FIXME" for each stored determination. After the source changes it asserts that "Recorded true" is still shown and "citations changed" is not. Every determination variant is covered. - Provenance and measurements stay out of the book: `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[book_ignores_saved_measurements_and_preserves_artifacts]` records an attempt with a measurement and a distinctive test name. It asserts that the populated chapters are identical to those rendered with no saved data. It asserts that the test name is absent and that invalid or empty attempt metadata leaves the output unchanged. It asserts that the artifacts are preserved. It asserts that the overview omits "Line coverage:", "Captured source", "Test runs and provenance", "selected test attempts" and "habeas-coverage-test". The `check.rs` test also asserts that "CI would" is absent. Both tests carry `{test}` markers for the subject. I found no unchecked obligation and no marking gap.
